newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble eases with most month-end payments over.
newsitem.headline: Rouble eases with most month-end payments over.

text.p: The rouble eased in calm speculative trading on Friday and dealers said rouble supply was higher as most month-end payments had been made.
"Rouble rates are lower as banks have finished their own and their clients' payments," United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said.
Another dealer said speculative selling was behind the rouble's decline.

Roubles for today settlement were quoted at 5,458-60 per dollar, the same as in early trading. They were at 5,452-55 per dollar late on Thursday. Tomorrow roubles eased to 5,461-63 per dollar from yesterday's late 5,456-58.
The central bank said it had set 5,453/5,463 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Friday.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 10-20 percent compared with Thursday's late 30-45 percent.
